canonical_claim.template: In 2025, Union Home Mortgage Corp. denied {value} of its 8,891 decisioned FHA applications.

required_qualifiers.population: Union Home Mortgage Corp. decisioned FHA applications (actions 1,2,3; loan_type 2; reverse mortgages excluded)
required_qualifiers.nature: historical institutional aggregate, unadjusted for applicant mix

does_not_establish: Union Home Mortgage Corp. will deny any specific future application with 8.3% probability
Union Home Mortgage Corp. is stricter or more lenient than another lender for a given applicant
Union Home Mortgage Corp. discriminates or violates law
8.3% applies to Union Home Mortgage Corp.'s non-FHA lending
rule: Free text is the OUTPUT of evidence, not its input. Certify before you write.

proposed_use.proposed_sentence: This lender will likely reject YOUR application
